The retrieved docs show the pieces, but not a complete global setup. The project docs don't show the `Settings.llm` assignment or the `HuggingFaceEmbedding` import path, so those parts come from my general knowledge.

**From the docs:**

- The global default for embeddings is set on `Settings`: "Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]. You swap in a different class to change the default.
- The Ollama LLM is constructed like this: "from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/using_llms.md], with `model="llama3.3"`, `request_timeout=60.0`, and `context_window=8000`.
- The Ollama integration package is "`llama-index-llms-ollama`: Ollama (llama3, mistral, qwen, etc.)." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/llms/local.md]
- For embeddings, the docs say "`HuggingFaceEmbedding`... which runs any [Sentence Transformers](https://sbert.net/) model locally" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/llms/local.md]. The docs also describe a fully local stack: "A fully-local stack looks like:" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/privacy.md].

**From general knowledge (not confirmed by the retrieved docs):**

```python
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama
from llama_index.embeddings.huggingface import HuggingFaceEmbedding

Settings.llm = Ollama(model="llama3.3", request_timeout=60.0, context_window=8000)
Settings.embed_model = HuggingFaceEmbedding(model_name="BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5")
```

Install with `pip install llama-index-llms-ollama llama-index-embeddings-huggingface`. The embeddings package name is from general knowledge. Ollama must be running locally before you query.

Setting both `Settings.llm` and `Settings.embed_model` replaces the OpenAI defaults for components that don't receive their own models. I can't confirm from these docs that nothing else in your pipeline reaches OpenAI, so check your setup for any component that sets its own model.
